name: RCRV: corridor inside the real ship (example)
source: estimated example placed in the real RCRV production model
provenance_note: The ship around this scene is the real ShipConstructor production model (shown see-through). The corridor, door, stair and guard rail are a simplified, estimated example placed at deck level 4 (+9.5 m) of the real deckhouse; their dimensions are fictional test values, not measured from the model or GA drawings. Ship particulars as in the other RCRV scenarios.
